text: Governance of Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAO) and the Legal Nature of Smart Contracts presents the following source proposition: 인간의 개입 없이 기능하는 탈중앙화 자율조직은 공상과학 소설에서나 나올 법한 것처럼 보일 수 있지만, 블록체인 기반 DAO는 비트코인이 탄생한 이래로 현실이 되었다. This proposition is pertinent to Kaal's source-bound claim that The immutability of blockchain ledgers is itself a vulnerability, because once a DAO is in operation its essential construction is very difficult to alter should a bug in the code appear. The proposed response is an extension: the relationship should remain limited to the retrieved source proposition and the mapped Kaal claim unless fuller source review supports a broader conclusion.
